en.s: The Battle of Bagrevand was fought on 25 April 775, in the plains of Bagrevand, between the forces of the Armenian princes who had rebelled against the Abbasid Caliphate and the caliphal army. The battle resulted in a crushing Abbasid victory, with the death of the main Armenian leaders. The Mamikonian family's power in particular was almost extinguished. The battle signalled the beginning of large-scale Armenian migration into the Byzantine Empire.

zh.s: 巴格雷万战役于775年4月25日在巴格雷万平原进行，交战双方是反抗阿拔斯哈里发国的亚美尼亚诸侯军队和哈里发军队。阿拔斯军队大获全胜，亚美尼亚主要领袖阵亡。马米科尼扬家族的势力几乎被彻底摧毁。此战也标志着亚美尼亚人开始大规模迁往拜占庭帝国。

en.s: The battle of Dan-no-ura (壇ノ浦の戦い Dan-no-ura no tatakai) was a major sea battle of the Genpei War, occurring at Dan-no-ura, in the Shimonoseki Strait off the southern tip of Honshū. On April 25, 1185, the Genji (Minamoto) clan fleet, led by Minamoto no Yoshitsune, defeated the Heike (Taira) clan fleet. The morning rip tide was an advantage to the Taira in the morning but turned to their disadvantage in the afternoon. The young Emperor Antoku was one of those who perished amongst the Taira nobles.

zh.s: 坛之浦海战（日语：壇ノ浦の戦い，Dan-no-ura no tatakai）是源平合战期间的一场重要海战，地点在本州岛南端外海、下关海峡的坛之浦。1185年4月25日，源氏（源）一族的舰队在源义经率领下击败平氏（平）一族的舰队。上午的涨潮对平氏有利，下午潮势转变后则对其不利。年幼的安德天皇是战死的平氏贵族之一。

en.s: In 1185, Prince John of England visited the island of Ireland as part of a campaign to secure the influence of the House of Plantagenet and the Crown of England, who planned to set up a Kingdom of Ireland within the Angevin Empire. John was himself a future king of England, the son of Henry II of England, and had been declared Lord of Ireland by his father at the Council of Oxford in 1177.

zh.s: 1185年，英格兰王子约翰前往爱尔兰，试图巩固金雀花王朝和英格兰王室的影响力。当时王室计划在安茹帝国内建立爱尔兰王国。约翰是英格兰国王亨利二世之子，后来也成为英格兰国王；1177年，他的父亲在牛津会议上授予他爱尔兰领主的头衔。

en.s: The War of Padua was a conflict in 1404–1405 between the Republic of Venice and the Carrarese lordship of Padua. In the power vacuum produced by the death of the Duke of Milan, Gian Galeazzo Visconti, in 1402, Francesco II da Carrara endeavored to expand into the Veneto and capture cities held by Visconti troops. These designs alarmed Venice, which allied with Milan to counter the common threat posed by the Carrarese state, and for the first time adopted a policy of direct intervention in the affairs of its hinterland. The war began with the Carrarese move against Verona and Vicenza in April 1404. While Verona was taken, Vicenza instead surrendered to Venice on 25 April 1404, thwarting Carrarese designs.

zh.s: 1404至1405年，威尼斯共和国与帕多瓦的卡拉雷西领地爆发战争。米兰公爵詹·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂于1402年去世后出现权力真空，弗朗切斯科二世·达·卡拉拉试图向威尼托扩张，夺取维斯孔蒂军队控制的城市。威尼斯对此感到不安，与米兰结盟应对卡拉雷西家族的共同威胁，并首次采取直接干预其腹地事务的政策。卡拉雷西于1404年4月向维罗纳和维琴察进军，战争由此开始。卡拉雷西攻占维罗纳，但维琴察于4月25日向威尼斯投降，挫败了卡拉雷西的计划。

en.s: The Battle of Hedgeley Moor, 25 April 1464, was a battle of the Wars of the Roses. It was fought at Hedgeley Moor, north of the village of Glanton in Northumberland, between a Yorkist army led by John Neville, 1st Marquess of Montagu and a Lancastrian army led by the Duke of Somerset. The battle ended in a Yorkist victory.

zh.s: 玫瑰战争期间，赫奇利沼泽战役于1464年4月25日在诺森伯兰郡格兰顿村以北爆发。约克派军队由蒙塔古侯爵约翰·内维尔率领，兰开斯特派军队由萨默塞特公爵率领。约克派获胜。

en.s: The Albanian–Ottoman Wars (1432–1479) were a series of wars and revolts against the rising Ottoman Empire by Albanian feudal lords. The wars and revolts took place in present-day Albania, Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia and South Serbia. In this period, Albanians under the leadership of Gjergj Arianiti and especially later under Skanderbeg resisted the Ottomans under two Sultans.

zh.t: 阿尔巴尼亚—奥斯曼战争（1432—1479年）
zh.s: 阿尔巴尼亚—奥斯曼战争（1432—1479年）是阿尔巴尼亚封建领主反抗日渐崛起的奥斯曼帝国的一系列战争和起义。战事发生在今天的阿尔巴尼亚、黑山、科索沃、北马其顿和塞尔维亚南部。当时，在格耶尔吉·阿里亚尼蒂、尤其是后来斯坎德培的领导下，阿尔巴尼亚人抵抗了两位苏丹统治下的奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The siege of Shkodra (Albanian: Rrethimi i Shkodrës) took place from May 1478 to April 1479 as a confrontation between the Ottoman Empire and the Venetians together with the League of Lezhë and other Albanians at Shkodra (Scutari in Italian) and its Rozafa Castle during the First Ottoman-Venetian War (1463–1479). Ottoman historian Franz Babinger called the siege "one of the most remarkable episodes in the struggle between the West and the Crescent".

zh.s: 斯库台围城战（阿尔巴尼亚语：Rrethimi i Shkodrës）发生于1478年5月至1479年4月。第一次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争期间，奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯、莱什联盟及其他阿尔巴尼亚势力在斯库台（意大利语称斯库塔里）及其罗扎法城堡交战。奥斯曼历史学家弗朗茨·巴宾格称这场围城战是“西方与新月势力斗争中最非凡的事件之一”。

en.s: The Battle of Pianosa was a naval engagement which took place on 25 April, 1519, when a Genoese fleet severely defeated the flotilla of the Tunisia-based Barbary corsair Kaid Ali in the Tyrrhenian Sea, in view of the island of Elba. The battle broke the back of one of the rising corsair bases on the Barbary Coast, Bizerte, and established Andrea Doria as among the foremost captains in the Mediterranean.

zh.s: 皮亚诺萨海战于1519年4月25日爆发，地点在第勒尼安海、厄尔巴岛附近。热那亚舰队重创突尼斯巴巴里海盗头目卡伊德·阿里的舰队。此战重创了巴巴里海岸一处正在崛起的海盗基地比塞大，并使安德烈亚·多里亚跻身地中海最杰出的舰队指挥官之列。

en.s: The naval Battle of Gibraltar took place on 25 April 1607 during the Eighty Years' War when a Dutch fleet surprised and engaged a Spanish fleet anchored at the Bay of Gibraltar. During the four hours of action, most of the Spanish ships were destroyed.

zh.s: 八十年战争期间，荷兰舰队于1607年4月25日在直布罗陀湾突袭并攻击一支停泊的西班牙舰队。交战持续四小时，大多数西班牙舰船被摧毁。

en.s: The Battle of Dessau Bridge (German: Schlacht bei Dessau) was a significant battle of the Thirty Years' War between Danish Protestants and the Imperial German Catholic forces on the Elbe River outside of Dessau, Germany on April 25, 1626. This battle was an attempt by Ernst von Mansfeld to cross the Dessau Bridge in order to invade the headquarters of the Imperial German army in Magdeburg, Germany. The Dessau bridge was the only land access between Magdeburg and Dresden, which made it difficult for the Danes to advance.

zh.s: 德绍桥战役（德语：Schlacht bei Dessau）是三十年战争期间丹麦新教军队与神圣罗马帝国天主教军队之间的一场重要战斗。战斗于1626年4月25日在德国德绍以外的易北河畔进行。恩斯特·冯·曼斯费尔德试图渡过德绍桥，进攻帝国军队在德国马格德堡的总部。德绍桥是连接马格德堡和德累斯顿的唯一陆路通道，使丹麦军队难以推进。

en.s: The Battle of Kartarpur occurred on 25 April 1635. It was the final major military engagement of Guru Hargobind, the sixth Sikh Guru, against the imperial forces of the Mughal Empire. Following previous Sikh victories in the Battle of Amritsar (1634) and Battle of Lahira, tensions between the Guru and Shah Jahan had reached a peak. The battle occurred in the locality of Kartarpur in present-day Jalandhar district of Indian Punjab.

zh.s: 卡塔普尔战役于1635年4月25日爆发，是第六代锡克教古鲁哈戈宾德与莫卧儿帝国军队之间最后一场重要战斗。锡克军此前在1634年阿姆利则战役和拉希拉战役中获胜后，与沙贾汗之间的紧张局势达到顶点。战斗地点是今印度旁遮普邦贾朗达尔县的卡塔普尔地区。

en.s: Battle of Sourton Down was a battle of the first English civil war that took place on 25 April 1643. Sourton Down lies on the edge of Dartmoor west of Okehampton in Devon. The battle involved Cornish Royalist troops under Sir Ralph Hopton who were ambushed by Major-General James Chudleigh with his cavalry. Captain Drake also led a charge against Royalist dragoons. Other Royalist commanders included Lord Mohun, Sir Bevil Grenville and Sir Nicholas Slanning. The Parliamentarians attacked but were eventually driven back and the Royalists took up defensive positions among ancient earthworks on the moor.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，索顿丘战役于1643年4月25日爆发。索顿丘位于德文郡奥克汉普顿以西、达特穆尔边缘。拉尔夫·霍普顿爵士率领的康沃尔保王党军队遭到詹姆斯·查德利少将的骑兵伏击；德雷克上尉也率军冲击保王党龙骑兵。其他保王党指挥官包括莫洪勋爵、贝维尔·格伦维尔爵士和尼古拉斯·斯兰宁爵士。议会军发动进攻后最终被击退，保王党转而在荒原上的古代土垒间设防。

en.s: The siege of Reading was an eleven-day blockade of Reading, Berkshire during the First English Civil War. Reading had been garrisoned by 3,000 Royalist troops under Sir Arthur Aston in November 1642. On 14 April 1643, Robert Devereux, 3rd Earl of Essex led a Parliamentarian army of 19,000 troops to lay siege to the town, and began bombarding it two days later.

zh.s: 雷丁围城战是第一次英国内战期间对伯克郡雷丁进行的一场为期11天的围困。1642年11月，3,000名保王党军队在亚瑟·阿斯顿爵士率领下驻守雷丁。1643年4月14日，埃塞克斯伯爵罗伯特·德弗罗率领1.9万名议会军抵达并围困该镇，两天后开始炮击。

en.s: The Jiashen Incident (simplified Chinese: 甲申之变; traditional Chinese: 甲申之變), also known as the Battle of Beijing, took place in 1644 in the areas surrounding Beijing, and was fought between forces of the incumbent Ming dynasty and the Shun dynasty founded by peasant rebel leader Li Zicheng. It eventually resulted in the collapse of the Ming dynasty.

en.s: The Morean war (Italian: Guerra di Morea), also known as the Sixth Ottoman–Venetian War, was fought between 1684–1699 as part of the wider conflict known as the "Great Turkish War", between the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire. Military operations ranged from Dalmatia to the Aegean Sea, but the war's major campaign was the Venetian conquest of the Morea (Peloponnese) peninsula in southern Greece.

zh.s: 莫兰战争（意大利语：Guerra di Morea），又称第六次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争，于1684年至1699年间进行，是更广泛的“大土耳其战争”的一部分，交战双方为威尼斯共和国和奥斯曼帝国。军事行动从达尔马提亚延伸至爱琴海，但战争的主要战役是威尼斯征服希腊南部的莫兰（伯罗奔尼撒）半岛。

en.s: The Battle of Almansa, fought on 25 April 1707, was one of the most decisive engagements of the War of the Spanish Succession. At Almansa, the Franco–Spanish army under Berwick soundly defeated the allied forces of Portugal, England, and the United Provinces led by the Earl of Galway, reclaiming most of eastern Spain for the Bourbons. It has been described as "probably the only Battle in history in which the English forces were commanded by a Frenchman, the French by an Englishman."

zh.s: 阿尔曼萨战役于1707年4月25日爆发，是西班牙王位继承战争中最具决定性的一场战斗之一。贝里克率领的法西联军在阿尔曼萨大败由戈尔韦伯爵率领的葡萄牙、英国和尼德兰联军，帮助波旁王朝收复西班牙东部大部分地区。这场战役被称为“也许是历史上唯一一次英国军队由法国人指挥、法国军队由英国人指挥的战斗”。

en.s: The Battle of Blandford (or Blanford), also called the Battle of Petersburg, took place near Petersburg, Virginia on 25 April 1781, late in the American War of Independence. Roughly 2,300 British regulars under the command of Brigadier General William Phillips defeated about 1,000 militia under Major General Baron von Steuben. The introduction of a British troop presence led by turncoat general Benedict Arnold into Virginia in early 1781 prompted an increase in militia activity to counter the British force. The militia were, however, poorly trained and equipped, and were unable to prevent Arnold from moving freely.

zh.s: 布兰德福德战役又称彼得斯堡战役，于1781年4月25日在美国独立战争后期、弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡附近进行。威廉·菲利普斯准将率领约2300名英国正规军，击败了斯图本男爵少将指挥的约1000名民兵。1781年初，叛变将领本尼迪克特·阿诺德率领英国部队进驻弗吉尼亚，促使民兵加强行动以抵抗英军。然而，民兵训练和装备不足，未能阻止阿诺德自由行动。

en.s: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill (sometimes referred to as the Second Battle of Camden) was a battle of the American Revolutionary War fought on April 25, 1781, near Camden, South Carolina. A small American army under Nathanael Greene defended a ridge known as Hobkirk's Hill against an attack by an even smaller British force led by Francis Rawdon. After a fierce clash, Greene retreated a few miles, leaving Rawdon's soldiers in possession of the hill. The battlefield marker is located at Broad Street and Greene Street north of the center of Camden. Even though Rawdon was the victor, he soon fell back to Camden.

zh.s: 霍布柯克山战役又称第二次卡姆登战役，于1781年4月25日在美国独立战争期间、南卡罗来纳州卡姆登附近进行。纳撒尼尔·格林率领一支小规模美军，守卫名为霍布柯克山的山脊，抵御弗朗西斯·罗登率领的规模更小的英军进攻。激战后，格林撤退数英里，罗登部队占据了山脊。战场纪念碑位于卡姆登市中心以北的布罗德街和格林街交口。虽然罗登赢得战斗，他很快也撤回卡姆登。

en.s: The Battle of Trangen took place on 25 April 1808 at Trangen in Flisa, Hedemarkens Amt, between Swedish and Norwegian troops, as a part of the Dano-Swedish War of 1808–1809. The invading Swedish troops, led by Colonel Carl Pontus Gahn, were surrounded and forced to surrender by the Norwegian troops under the command of Bernhard Ditlef von Staffeldt. Gahn and around 450 of his troops were captured.

zh.s: 丹麦—瑞典战争期间，瑞典和挪威军队于1808年4月25日在弗利萨的特兰根交战。卡尔·庞图斯·加恩上校率领的瑞典入侵部队被包围，迫使投降。伯恩哈德·迪特勒夫·冯·施塔费尔特指挥挪威军队，俘虏了加恩及其约450名部下。

en.s: The Battle of Radzymin took place on April 25, 1809 during the brief Polish–Austrian War. The battle occurred at Radzymin, some 20 kilometres (12 mi) north-east of Warsaw. Following the Austrian defeat in the Battle of Raszyn on April 19, the Polish forces commanded by Prince Józef Poniatowski left Warsaw undefended and withdrew to several fortresses located nearby (most notably to Modlin Fortress and Serock). The Austrians seized the Polish capital relatively easy, but it was a pyrrhic victory, as the Austrian force was now seriously overstretched and had a still unbeaten enemy in the vicinity of Warsaw, as well as new Polish forces gathering strength behind their lines in Greater Poland.

zh.s: 1809年4月25日，波奥战争期间发生拉济明战役，地点在华沙东北约20公里处的拉济明。4月19日奥军在拉申战役中战败后，约瑟夫·波尼亚托夫斯基亲王指挥的波兰军队放弃华沙，撤往附近数座要塞，尤其是莫德林要塞和塞罗茨克。奥军相对轻易地占领波兰首都，但这是一场代价高昂的胜利：奥军兵力过度分散，华沙附近仍有一支未被击败的敌军，大波兰地区也有新的波兰部队正在集结壮大。

en.s: The Mexican–American War, also known in the United States as the Mexican War and in Mexico as the United States intervention in Mexico, (April 25, 1846 – February 2, 1848) was an invasion of Mexico by the United States. It followed the 1845 American annexation of Texas, which Mexico still considered its territory because it refused to recognize the Treaties of Velasco, signed by President Antonio López de Santa Anna after he was captured by the Texian Army during the 1836 Texas Revolution.

zh.s: 美墨战争在美国也称墨西哥战争，在墨西哥则称美国干涉墨西哥战争，于1846年4月25日至1848年2月2日进行，是美国对墨西哥发动的一场入侵。战争发生在美国于1845年吞并得克萨斯之后。墨西哥拒绝承认《贝拉斯科条约》，仍将得克萨斯视为本国领土；该条约由墨西哥总统安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳于1836年德克萨斯革命期间被德克萨斯军队俘虏后签署。

en.s: The Thornton Affair was a battle in 1846 between the military forces of the United States and Mexico 20 miles (32 km) west upriver from Zachary Taylor's camp along the Rio Grande. The much larger Mexican force defeated the Americans in the opening of hostilities, and was the primary justification for U.S. President James K. Polk's call to Congress to declare war.

zh.s: 1846年，美国和墨西哥军队在扎卡里·泰勒位于格兰德河沿岸的营地以西、河上游约20英里（32公里）处交战，这场战斗被称为桑顿事件。人数远多于美军的墨西哥军队击败了美军，战斗由此拉开敌对行动的序幕，也是美国总统詹姆斯·K·波尔克要求国会宣战的主要理由。

en.t: Burning of the Parliament Buildings in Montreal
en.s: The burning of the Parliament Buildings in Montreal occurred on the night of April 25, 1849, in Montreal, the then-capital of the Province of Canada. The way the matter was handled by then co-prime ministers of the united Province of Canada, Sir Louis-Hippolyte Lafontaine and Robert Baldwin, helped develop the Canadian democratic tradition. It also caused the capital to be moved elsewhere, eventually being installed in Ottawa.

zh.t: 蒙特利尔议会大楼遭焚毁
zh.s: 1849年4月25日晚，时任加拿大省首府蒙特利尔的议会大楼遭焚毁。当时加拿大联合省两位共同总理路易-伊波利特·拉方丹爵士和罗伯特·鲍德温处理此事的方式，推动了加拿大民主传统的发展。此事也导致首府迁往他处，最终定于渥太华。

Having fought past Forts Jackson and St. Philip, the Union was unopposed in its capture of the city itself. Many residents resented the controversial and confrontational administration of the city by its U.S.

zh.s: 1862年4月25日至5月1日，美国内战中的新奥尔良夺城行动展开。联邦军此前已突破杰克逊堡和圣菲利普堡，夺取市区时没有遭遇军事抵抗；这一转折为控制密西西比河创造了条件。4月25日，法拉格特派军官入城要求投降，却遭市政与军事当局拒绝。此后，不少居民对美军占领下的城市管理心怀不满。

en.s: The Battle of Marks' Mills (April 25, 1864) occurred in present-day Cleveland County, Arkansas as part of the American Civil War. Confederate Brigadier-General James Fagan, having made a forced march, attacked a train of several hundred wagons, guarded by a brigade of infantry, 500 cavalry, and a section of light artillery under command of Lieutenant Colonel Francis M. Drake of the 36th Iowa, on its way from Camden to Pine Bluff for supplies. F.M. Drake had a reputation as an Indian fighter; in 1854 he led a wagon train from Iowa to Sacramento California and, while crossing the Nebraska prairie, his train was attacked by an estimated 700 Pawnee warriors.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，马克斯磨坊战役于1864年4月25日在今阿肯色州克利夫兰县发生。詹姆斯·费根准将率领邦联军强行军后，袭击一支数百辆马车组成的补给车队。车队由第36爱荷华步兵团的弗朗西斯·M·德雷克中校指挥，护卫包括一个步兵旅、500名骑兵和一支轻炮部队。德雷克以猎杀原住民闻名；1854年，他曾率领一支马车队从爱荷华州前往加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托，途中在内布拉斯加草原遭到约700名波尼人袭击。

en.s: The initial content of this article was taken from. Please add inline citations to subsequent additions. The Second Battle of Charasiab was fought on 25 April 1880 between the British and Afghans during the Second Anglo-Afghan War. A force led by Colonel Jenkins found itself surrounded by the Logaris near Charasiab. An infantry column led by MacPherson, and accompanied by a Cavalry brigade and four horse artillery guns, was sent to support Jenkins. Upon their arrival the Afghans were routed and were pursued by the cavalry and horse artillery for four miles.

zh.t: 第二次查拉西亚布战役
zh.s: 1880年4月25日，第二次英阿战争期间，英军与阿富汗部落武装在查拉西亚布附近交战。詹金斯上校率部被洛加里人包围，麦克弗森随后率步兵纵队、骑兵旅及四门马炮前去增援。阿富汗部队被击溃后，骑兵与马炮又追击了约四英里。

en.s: The Battle of Hanoi on 25 April 1882, was the illegal capture by French naval captain Henri Rivière, acting without his superiors' orders. The French handed the city back later. The Citadel of Hanoi was almost totally unprepared and the entire attack lasted less than an hour, and ended with only four French soldiers wounded.

It was the first election in Australia in which women could vote, following the passing of the Constitutional Amendment (Adult Suffrage) Act 1894 two years prior.

en.s: The Action of 25 April 1898 was a minor single ship action of the Spanish–American War fought near Cárdenas, Cuba, between the American torpedo boat USS Foote under Lieutenant William Ledyard Rodgers and the Spanish gunboat Ligera under Lieutenant Antonio Pérez Rendón. After a fierce exchange of fire, Foote, seriously damaged, was forced to withdraw. The engagement was the first battle of the war, as well as the first naval Spanish success.

zh.s: 1898年4月25日海战是美西战争期间发生的一场小规模单舰交战，地点在古巴卡德纳斯附近。美国鱼雷艇“富特号”由威廉·莱德亚德·罗杰斯中尉指挥，西班牙炮艇“利赫拉号”由安东尼奥·佩雷斯·伦东中尉指挥。经过激烈交火，严重受损的“富特号”被迫撤退。这是战争中的第一场战斗，也是西班牙首场海战胜利。

en.t: United States declaration of war on Spain
en.s: On 25 April 1898, the United States Congress declared war upon Spain. The ensuing Spanish–American War resulted in a decisive victory for the United States, and arguably served as a transitional period for both nations. Spain saw its days of empire fade, as the United States saw the prospect of overseas empire emerge. The war was ended by the Treaty of Paris signed on December 10 that same year.

zh.s: 1898年4月25日，美国国会对西班牙宣战。随后的美西战争以美国取得决定性胜利告终，也可视为两国历史的转折期。西班牙的帝国时代逐渐落幕，而美国开始展望海外帝国扩张。战争于同年12月10日签署《巴黎条约》后结束。

en.s: The Kincardineshire by-election, 1908 was a parliamentary by-election held for the British House of Commons constituency of Kincardineshire on 25 April 1908. The seat had become vacant when the sitting Liberal Member of Parliament John Crombie died on 22 March 1908. The election saw the picketting of polling stations by suffragettes protesting at the Liberal government's unwillingness to bring in votes for women. The Liberal candidate, Arthur Cecil Murray won the seat in a straight fight with his Conservative opponent S J Gammell.

zh.s: 英国下议院金卡丁郡选区于1908年4月25日举行议会补选。时任自由党议员约翰·克朗普里于3月22日去世，导致席位空缺。选举期间，支持女性选举权的妇女参政论者封锁投票站，抗议自由党政府不愿推动女性选举权法案。自由党候选人亚瑟·塞西尔·默里在与保守党候选人S·J·甘梅尔的直接对决中获胜。

en.s: The 1908 FA Cup final was contested by Wolverhampton Wanderers and Newcastle United at Crystal Palace Park. This was their third FA Cup final appearance in four years (although they had yet to win). Their 6–0 thrashing of Fulham in the semi-final is a record win for a semi-final.

zh.s: 1908年英格兰足总杯决赛由伍尔弗汉普顿流浪者队对阵纽卡斯尔联队，比赛在水晶宫公园举行。纽卡斯尔本赛季刚在英格兰足球甲级联赛中排名第四，此前曾在1906—07赛季夺冠。这是纽卡斯尔四年内第三次闯入足总杯决赛，但此前还未夺冠。球队在半决赛中以6比0大胜富勒姆，这也是半决赛的最大比分胜利纪录。

en.s: The landing at Cape Helles (Turkish: Seddülbahir Çıkarması) was part of the Gallipoli campaign, the amphibious landings on the Gallipoli peninsula by British and French forces on 25 April 1915 during the First World War. Helles, at the foot of the peninsula, was the main landing area. With gunfire support from the Royal Navy, the 29th Division was to advance six mi (9.7 km) along the peninsula on the first day and seize the heights of Achi Baba.

zh.s: 海勒斯角登陆战（土耳其语：Seddülbahir Çıkarması）是加里波利战役的一部分。第一次世界大战期间，英国和法国军队于1915年4月25日在加里波利半岛登陆。海勒斯角位于半岛最南端，是主要登陆地点。皇家海军提供炮火支援，第29师计划在首日沿半岛推进6英里（9.7公里），并夺取阿奇巴巴高地。

Kumkale is the name of a village which now is a part of Troy national park.

en.s: Nazi Germany, officially the German Reich and later the Greater German Reich, was the German state between 1933 and 1945, when Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party controlled the country, transforming it into a totalitarian dictatorship. en.s: James Dewey Watson (April 6, 1928 – November 6, 2025) was an American molecular biologist, geneticist, and zoologist. In 1953, James Watson and Francis Crick co-authored an academic paper on DNA entitled, "Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: A Structure for Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid". en.s: The Carnation Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução dos Cravos), also referred to as the 25 April (Portuguese: 25 de Abril), was initially a military coup in Lisbon, Portugal, on 25 April 1974 which overthrew the regime of the Estado Novo. The revolution started as a military coup organized by the Armed Forces Movement (Portuguese: Movimento das Forças Armadas, MFA) composed of military officers who opposed the regime, but the movement was soon coupled with an unanticipated and popular campaign of civil resistance. This movement would lead to the fall of the Estado Novo and the withdrawal of Portugal from its African colonies and East Timor.

zh.s: 康乃馨革命（葡萄牙语：Revolução dos Cravos），也称“4月25日革命”（葡萄牙语：25 de Abril），最初是1974年4月25日在葡萄牙里斯本发动的一场军事政变，推翻了新国家体制。政变由反对该政权的军官组成的武装部队运动组织。此后，原本是政变的行动意外发展为大规模和平公民抵抗，最终导致新国家体制垮台，葡萄牙退出其在非洲的殖民地和东帝汶。

en.s: The Portuguese Constituent Assembly election, 1975 was carried out in Portugal on 25 April 1975, exactly one year after the Carnation Revolution. It was the first free election held in Portugal since 1925, and only the seventh free election in all of Portuguese history. Turnout was 91.66 percent--at the time, the highest ever. The main aim of the election was the election of a Constituent Assembly, in order to write a new Constitution to replace the Estado Novo regime's authoritarian Constitution of 1933 and so this freely-elected parliament had a single-year mandate and no government was based on parliamentary support; the country continued to be governed by a military-civilian provisional administration during the deliberations of the Constituent Assembly.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1975年4月25日举行制宪议会选举，正好是康乃馨革命一周年。这是葡萄牙自1925年以来首次举行自由选举，也是该国历史上第七次自由选举。投票率为91.66%，当时创下历史纪录。选举的主要目的是选出制宪议会，为取代新国家体制1933年威权宪法而制定新宪法。这个通过自由选举产生的议会任期只有一年，政府不以议会支持为基础；在制宪议会讨论期间，葡萄牙继续由军民临时政府治理。

en.s: Dan-Air Flight 1008 was a fatal accident involving a Boeing 727-46 jet aircraft operated by Dan Air Services Limited on a chartered international passenger service from Manchester to Tenerife. en.s: Extreme Rules (2010) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) and presented by KFC, which took place on April 25, 2010, at the 1st Mariner Arena in Baltimore, Maryland. It was the second event promoted under the Extreme Rules name. There were eight matches scheduled on the event's card, all of which featured an extreme stipulation, with no regular singles matches on the card. The event received 182,000 pay-per-view buys, the same as the figure achieved by the 2009 Backlash event.

en.s: The Austrian presidential election took place on 25 April 2010. It was the twelfth election of an Austrian head of state since 1951. The candidates were President Heinz Fischer (independent, formerly SPÖ), Barbara Rosenkranz (FPÖ) and Rudolf Gehring (CPÖ). Heinz Fischer won with just under 80% of the valid votes. The turnout was on the historic low of about 54%.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Togo on 25 April 2015. Initially scheduled for 15 April 2015, the election was postponed by ten days at the recommendation of John Dramani Mahama, President of Ghana and acting chair of the ECOWAS organization. Incumbent President Faure Gnassingbé was seeking a third term and was opposed by four other candidates, including the main opposition leader Jean-Pierre Fabre of the National Alliance for Change. Provisional results by the National Independent Election Commission declared Gnassingbé the winner with about 59% of the vote, whilst Fabre received 35%. Fabre called the results a "crime against national sovereignty", saying he considered himself the new president.

en.s: The April 2015 Nepal earthquake (also known as the Gorkha earthquake) killed nearly 9,000 people and injured nearly 22,000. It occurred at 11:56 Nepal Standard Time on 25 April, with a magnitude of 7.8Mw or 8.1Ms and a maximum Mercalli Intensity of IX (Violent). Its epicenter was east of Gorkha District at Barpak, Gorkha, and its hypocenter was at a depth of approximately 8.2 km (5.1 mi). It was the worst natural disaster to strike Nepal since the 1934 Nepal–Bihar earthquake. The ground motion recorded in Kathmandu valley was of long period that cause the limited human and property loss in kathmandu valley.

zh.s: 2015年4月尼泊尔地震又称廓尔喀地震，造成近9000人死亡、近22000人受伤。地震于4月25日尼泊尔标准时间11时56分发生，矩震级7.8级或面波震级8.1级，最高麦加利烈度为IX级（剧烈）。震中位于廓尔喀县巴尔帕克以东，震源深度约8.2公里（5.1英里）。这是自1934年尼泊尔—比哈尔地震以来袭击尼泊尔的最严重自然灾害。加德满都谷地记录到的地面运动周期较长，因此该地人员和财产损失有限。
